description: Verify deployed smart-contract source on Etherscan, Blockscout, Sourcify and Routescan from a browser, a backend or a CLI, with one API.
rules: Run a dry run first (dryRun() or explorer-verify verify --dry-run). A submit publishes the source on the explorer and cannot be undone, so submit only when the person asked to verify that contract on that chain.
Etherscan keys stay on a server. A browser verifies on Etherscan only through the server handler from createVerifyHandler() in explorer-verify/server, which holds the key.
The CLI reads a key from ETHERSCAN_API_KEY, ROUTESCAN_API_KEY or BLOCKSCOUT_API_KEY, or from --api-key-file or --api-key-stdin. Never pass a key as a flag value; the CLI refuses such flags.
